lines.en: label mikusummer2nightgen:
scene mikusummer2nightgen

I call Miku and the two of us wind up making a trip to a nearby fast food restaurant so she can replenish her energy stores with what is potentially the least healthy thing you can put inside of your body.
lines.zh: 我给 Miku 打了电话，最后我们俩跑了一趟附近的快餐店，好让她用这种大概是你所能塞进身体里最不健康的东西，来补满她的能量储备。

lines.en: But hey, if she wants to jeopardize her future self now while she is still young and able-bodied, she’s allowed to do so.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，如果她想趁现在还年轻、身体还健全的时候，拿未来的自己冒险，那也是她的自由。

lines.en: And I say this as a young-ish and mostly able-bodied male who is about to put the same things into {i}his{/i} body.
lines.zh: 而我可是以一个还算年轻、身体大体健全、并且马上就要把同样的东西塞进{i}自己{/i}身体的男人的身份说这话的。

lines.en: Either way, it feels nice and...surprisingly natural to come to places like this with Miku.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，和 Miku 来这种地方感觉很好，而且……出奇地自然。

lines.en: If she wasn’t half my age, I might even say something along the lines of how she feels a bit like some sort of childhood friend.
lines.zh: 如果她不是只有我一半年纪，我甚至可能会说，她给人的感觉有点像某个青梅竹马。

lines.en: Which, honestly, doesn’t sound so bad because the only childhood friend I do have yells at me all the time and the only times I’ve heard Miku yell have been extremely depressing and not at all personal.
lines.zh: 说实话这听起来也不坏，因为我唯一的那位青梅竹马整天冲我吼，而我听到 Miku 喊叫的仅有的几次，都极其令人沮丧，而且完全不是冲着我来的。

lines.en: scene black
We get our food and settle down at a table near the window and wind up talking about how life has changed lately.
lines.zh: 我们拿了吃的，在靠窗的桌子旁坐下，最后聊起了最近生活发生了怎样的变化。

lines.en: For her, it’s mostly about the swim club and how she’s in the process of trying to convince some of the girls from the disbanded soccer team to swap clubs.
lines.zh: 对她来说，主要是游泳社的事，还有她正在设法说服那支已经解散的足球队里的一些女生转社。

lines.en: For me, it’s about the direction our relationship has headed in.
lines.zh: 对我来说，是我们这段关系走向了什么方向。

lines.en: Is that the most substantial change my life has made as of late?
lines.zh: 这是我最近生活里最重大的变化吗？

lines.en: Not at all.
But it’s the one that makes her blush, so it is the one that I will use.
lines.zh: 但这是唯一能让她脸红的那个，所以我就用这个了。
